sources.note: Vienna-based Bitpanda GmbH (founded 2014; ~7.4M registered users end-2025; €371M adjusted 2025 revenue). Separately, Fusion (the advanced spot exchange aggregating external liquidity) charges order-book commissions from roughly 0.02% maker / 0.15% taker (PROup/high-volume; consumer figures up to 0.25%) — NOT modeled as the default product but disclosed in notes. MiCA CASP authorization from BaFin 2025-01-27 (EEA30 passport) plus Austrian FMA authorization 2025-04; FMA imposed a €70,000 whitepaper-timing fine 2026-08-14 (first published Austrian MiCA penalty; license unaffected). Independent real-money measurement (TUM School of Management, Oct-Nov 2025, 50 standardized €100 round-trips): mean round-trip cost 6.23% with 4.25 pp undisclosed hidden markup vs the published schedule; replicated by the Frankfurt School Blockchain Center study (Mar 2026, 432 round-trips across 9 platforms). sources.note: BISON is the retail crypto app of Boerse Stuttgart Group (launched 2019, Stuttgart; 1M+ active users, 56 curated cryptocurrencies as of the 2026-01 press kit). The trading counterparty is EUWAX AG, which acts as a PRINCIPAL (customers buy from / sell to EUWAX); there is no order book and the quoted all-in price is valid for ~10 seconds. No order/deposit/withdrawal/custody fees: the only charge is a proportional per-side SPREAD averaging 1.25% for Bitcoin and Ethereum and 1.75% for ALL other cryptocurrencies (fluctuates with market conditions and trade size; a full round trip is ~2.5% BTC/ETH and ~3.5% other coins). Modeled headline tier is 1.75% with BTC/ETH 1.25% pair overrides in pair_fees.json; no volume ladder, no maker/taker distinction. Independent TUM real-money measurement (Oct-Nov 2025, standardized €100 round-trips across six platforms) realized a 2.58% mean round-trip vs the ~2.5% implied by the published spread — only ~0.08 pp hidden, the best published-vs-measured alignment in the sample. Stocks/ETFs (€1.99 per order, Germany only) and staking (27% commission on ETH/SOL rewards) are NOT crypto-trading fees and are not modeled; no futures, margin or derivatives — futures array intentionally empty. MiCAR: Boerse Stuttgart Digital Custody GmbH (formerly blocknox) was the FIRST BaFin MiCAR licensee (custody/transfer, 2025-01-17, 29-state passport); EUWAX AG holds BaFin MiCAR authorizations for exchange of crypto assets (2025-04-01, 8-state passport) and execution of orders (2025-11-21, Germany only). ccxt 4.5.78 ships no bison/euwax connector, so account-fee lookup is unsupported like Finst/Bitpanda.

sources.note: Tier thresholds and rates verified 2026-09 against official exchange fee pages/mirrors (OKX unified schedule effective 2026-08-14; KuCoin VIP structure updated 2026-05-07; Bitstamp unified schedule effective 2026-09-01). OKX/Bybit/Bitget spot+futures VIP7-9/Supreme makers can be zero or negative (maker rebates). Qualification: OKX/Bybit/Bitget = account assets OR 30-day volume per product line (higher of the two); Gate = volume OR GT holdings (higher of the two); KuCoin = per-product 30-day volume OR KCS holdings (higher of the two); Kraken = unified tier across spot+futures via 30d spot volume OR 30d futures volume OR assets on platform (higher of the tracks; Tier 1-2 have no asset path); Coinbase = 30-day volume only (no holdings track), hourly refresh; Binance spot VIP1+ requires volume AND BNB; Binance futures has no holding gate. MEXC = flat Standard tier (spot 0%/0.05%, futures 0.01%/0.04%); many pairs run 0-fee promos and futures 0-fee eligibility is account-specific. Hyperliquid = 14-day rolling volume (spot counts 2x) with a multiplicative staked-HYPE discount ladder (staking required, holding alone gives nothing); no KYC and the US front-end is geo-blocked. BingX = per-product 30-day volume OR previous-day account assets (higher of the two), with volume-only Elite and Supreme rungs that holdings cannot reach; VIP4+ and Supreme additionally require API-traded volume to stay at or below 20% of total volume. BloFin = per-product 30-day volume OR account assets (higher of the two) with a ≥80% non-API-volume condition at VIP4+; no native token. Bitstamp = 30-day volume only (no holdings track, no token); spot globally, futures EU/EEA-eligible only and country-gated. Re-verify before financial decisions.

notes: Kraken Pro unified 17-tier schedule since 2026-07-09: one tier applies to BOTH spot and futures, set by the highest of 30-day spot volume, 30-day futures volume (per-product thresholds below) or real-time assets on platform (AOP) — qualifying through one track suffices.

Tier 1 and Tier 2 have no AOP threshold (holdings cannot reach them). Stablecoin/forex pairs, Instant Buy and conversions do not count toward volume. For US/CA/NZ customers futures are unavailable or do not cross-qualify the unified tier (US customers trade CFTC-regulated perpetuals on the Kraken/Bitnomial platform, launched Jun 2026, 47 states, up to 5x).

Negative futures maker rates from Tier 11 are maker rebates paid by Kraken. Rates are Kraken Pro order-book rates; the Kraken consumer app instead charges 1% Instant Buy / 1.5% custom orders plus spread.
The single monthlyVolumeUsd input is matched against the ladder of the queried product; cross-product qualification (e.g. futures volume lifting the spot tier) is not modeled.

Advanced Trade quotes pure order-book maker/taker rates with no embedded spread; the consumer app instead charges ~1.5-4.99% all-in (variable fee + spread) plus a 1% limit-order execution fee on simple trades — not modeled here.

Tiers refresh hourly on 30-day rolling USD volume across ALL pairs; qualification is volume-only (no holdings track). Eligible stablecoin-stablecoin pairs trade at 0.00% maker, but USDT-USDC and USDT-USD are excluded from that program.
Coinbase One subscriptions waive simple-trade fees (capped by plan) and rebate part of Advanced fees in USDC for Preferred/Premium members; the schedule below is un-rebated list pricing.

US retail perpetual-style nano BTC/ETH futures (max 10x) are available via Coinbase Financial Markets since Jul 2025 (CFTC-registered); that fee schedule is not modeled, so futures comparisons exclude Coinbase.

Fully on-chain L1 order book (HyperCore) with zero gas on trading; perps are USDC-margined and the spot book quotes in USDC — deposits arrive via Circle CCTP V2 (min 5 USDC), withdrawals to Arbitrum and 22+ chains cost a flat ~1 USDC.

Tier qualification uses a 14-DAY rolling weighted volume window with daily UTC refresh (spot volume counts 2x), NOT the 30-day window other venues use — passing monthlyVolumeUsd prices it as if it were the 14-day window, so steady-pace traders' real tier may be one rung lower. Spot base rates sit above perp rates at every tier.

Staking-linked HYPE discount: staking 10/100/1k/10k/100k/500k HYPE gives 5/10/15/20/30/40% off ALL maker+taker fees, stacking MULTIPLICATIVELY with the volume tier. Staking is required — merely holding HYPE gives nothing. Price it via useToken=true + tokenBalance=<staked HYPE>.

Referral program: referred traders get 4% off fees on their first $25M of volume; referrers earn ~10% of fees on the referred user's first $1B. No operator link is configured here, so results carry no referral_url.

No KYC (wallet = identity). The US front-end is geo-blocked (ToS restricted-person list; policy momentum toward US re-entry reported Aug 2026); Canada is restricted only in Ontario; the UK is accessible but carries a 2026-05 FCA unauthorized-firm consumer warning.

Stable-to-stable spot pairs (e.g. USDC/USDH aligned quotes) carry deep taker discounts (up to -80%) and the market-maker share-of-volume rebate program runs -0.001% to -0.003% — both are per-market metadata and not modeled in the ladder below.

BingX VIP Club tiers qualify via the HIGHEST of three tracks: 30-day spot volume, 30-day Standard Contract (USDT-margined perpetual) futures volume, or previous-day account assets — one track suffices; levels refresh daily at 03:00 UTC+8.

The Elite and Supreme rungs are VOLUME-ONLY (they carry no asset threshold) — account assets can lift you to VIP1-VIP5 but can never reach Elite or Supreme. The single monthlyVolumeUsd input is matched against the queried product's own thresholds; cross-product qualification (e.g. futures volume lifting the spot tier) is not modeled.

VIP4, VIP5 and Supreme additionally require API-traded volume to stay at or below 20% of total 30-day volume; accounts above that ratio are reverted to lower rates. The engine assumes the ratio is satisfied.
The ladder below models the Standard Contract order-book book (perpetual futures). BingX 'Standard Futures' is a separate close-only copy-trading product charging a flat 0.045% and is not modeled.
No native exchange token fee discount exists. There is no operator referral link configured, so BingX results always compete at full undiscounted rates.

PRO order-book schedule below is the unified fee schedule effective 2026-09-01 (verified against bitstamp.net/fee-schedule): 11 rungs on a SINGLE 30-day cumulative USD-volume track — no holdings/assets track and no native exchange token.

notes: SPREAD-MODEL BROKER (default consumer app/web): no separate commission line — a per-side premium is embedded in the quoted price. Bands: 0.99% for BTC and stablecoins, 1.49% for most crypto assets (the modeled headline), up to 2.49% for small-cap tokens below €100m market cap; crypto-index baskets 1.99%. Same premium on buy and sell, at every order size — there is no volume ladder and no maker/taker distinction. Pair-specific 0.99% BTC/stablecoin pricing is applied automatically via pair_fees when a pair is supplied.

ADVANCED INTERFACE: Fusion is a separate order-book spot venue that aggregates external liquidity (Binance/Coinbase and others) with commissions from roughly 0.02% maker / 0.15% taker (up to 0.25% consumer tier) — NOT modeled as the default; users who place orders on Fusion pay order-book economics instead of the consumer premium.
The 2026-01-29 unified-platform stock/ETF trades (flat €1 per trade), metals, crypto-index management costs and staking reward spreads are not crypto-trading fees and are not modeled.

SPOT ONLY for crypto: no exchange-hosted futures or perpetuals (margin up to 10x exists on selected assets but is not modeled); the futures array is intentionally empty and Bitpanda classifies as unsupported_product for futures queries inside its service area.

MiCA CASP authorization from BaFin (2025-01-27, EEA30 passport) plus Austrian FMA authorization (2025-04); the FMA €70,000 fine of 2026-08-14 concerned whitepaper/marketing timing formalities and did not restrict the licence. UK service runs through Bitpanda Broker UK Ltd (FCA-registered cryptoasset business).

execution_quality.trades: 50 standardized €100 buy/sell round-trips over 12 trading days across six MiCAR-licensed platforms (BISON included in the six-platform sample)
execution_quality.study: TUM School of Management — Pricing Transparency in European Crypto Trading (real-money retail execution test across six MiCAR-licensed platforms)
execution_quality.note: The published 1.25%-per-side BTC/ETH spread predicts a 2.5% round-trip; the realized mean was 2.58% — an undisclosed markup of only ~0.08 pp, by far the closest published-vs-measured alignment of the six platforms tested (Bitvavo -0.58% measured next best; Bitpanda 6.23%, Coinbase 7.49%).

notes: SPREAD-MODEL BROKER (BISON app/web, powered by EUWAX AG as direct contractual counterparty — clients buy from and sell to EUWAX; there is no order book and each quoted price is valid for ~10 seconds): no separate commission, no deposit/withdrawal/custody fee — the only charge is a proportional per-side spread averaging 1.25% for Bitcoin and Ethereum and 1.75% for ALL other cryptocurrencies (the modeled headline). The spread fluctuates with market conditions and trade size; same spread on buy and sell at every order size — no volume ladder and no maker/taker distinction. Pair-specific 1.25% BTC/ETH pricing is applied automatically via pair_fees when a pair is supplied; a full round trip is ~2.5% on BTC/ETH and ~3.5% on other coins.
Stocks and ETFs (€1.99 flat per securities order, Germany only), the 27% staking reward commission (ETH/SOL) and crypto savings-plan features are not crypto-spot-trading fees and are not modeled.

SPOT ONLY for crypto: no exchange-hosted futures, perpetuals or margin trading; the futures array is intentionally empty and BISON classifies as unsupported_product for futures queries inside its service area.

Regulated 'Made in Germany' stack: Boerse Stuttgart Digital Custody GmbH (formerly blocknox) was the FIRST BaFin MiCAR licensee (custody + transfer services, authorized 2025-01-17, passported to 29 states); EUWAX AG is BaFin-authorized for exchanging crypto assets against funds/other crypto assets (2025-04-01, passport to 8 EEA states) and for execution of orders on behalf of clients (2025-11-21, Germany only). EUR balances sit in pooled trust accounts at Solaris SE and Deutsche Bank AG (€100,000 deposit insurance).
